2  ORDER 01.10.2024 Heard Ms. B. S. Goyal, learned counsel for the petitioner.
The present application is filed alleging willful and deliberate violation of order dated 23.02.2022 passed by this Court in WP(C) No. 1230/2022.

The operative portion of the aforesaid order is quoted herein below:-
"12.

Considering the above, the petitioner is directed to approach the concerned Competent Authority for Land Acquisiiton (CALA) in the district of Karbi Anglong by filing appropriate application under Section 3H(3) and 3H(4) of the National Highways Act, 1956 for redressal of his grievance.

13. In the event of any such application filed by the petitioner under Section 3H(3)
and 3H(4) of the National Highways Act, 1956 seeking redressal of his grievances before the concerned Competent Authority, the said authority shall do the needful with regard to the apportionment of compensation payable to the petitioner for taking over his land under the said 1956 Act, if any, in accordance with law and following the provision of Section 3H(3) and (4) of said 1956 Act".

Thus from the aforesaid, it is seen that the direction was specifically issued to the concerned Competent Authority for Land Acquisition (CALA) in the district of Karbi Anglong to do needful with regard to the apportionment of compensation payable to the petitioner.

The Competent Authority for Land Acquisition (CALA) in the Karbi Anglong district admittedly is respondent Nos. 7 and 8 i.e. the Competent Authority, Page No.# 4/4 Joint Secretary, I/C (Revenue) Karbi Anglong Autonomous Council, Diphu and The Joint Secretary to the Department of Revenue, Karbi Anglong Autonomous Council, Diphu respectively.

Therefore, in the considered opinion of this Court, the other respondents i.e. respondent Nos. 1, 2, 3,
4, 5, 6, 9 and 10 are not necessary party in the contempt petition and accordingly, their names be deleted from the array of parties.
Registry to do the needful in this regard.

The petitioner is permitted to take fresh steps for issuance of notice upon the respondent Nos. 7 and 8 by way of registered post with A/D as well as by usual process within a period five days from today.
List this matter after six weeks on a date to be fixed by the Registry.
